THE WAGES BOARDS ORDINANCE
Notification
WAGES BOARDS FOR THE HOTEL AND CATERING TRADE

It is hereby notified under Section 29(3) of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136), that the decisions of the Wages Boardfor the Hotel and Catering Trade made under Section 30 of that Ordinance and specified in the schedule hereto have beenapproved by the Hon. Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
The decision shall come into force on 01st of August 2018.
S. A. N. SARANATISSA,Secretary,Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo 05.26th July, 2018.SCHEDULE

The decisions made by the Wages Board for the Hotel and Catering Trade and set out in the Schedule to the Notificationpublished in Gazette Extraordinary No. 34 of 27th April, 1979 as varied from time to time and last varied by the Notificationpublished in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1789/19, of 18th December, 2012, shall be further varied as follows:
The minimum monthly rates of wages for time work applicable to the Workers of the below-mentioned classes of the Hoteland Catering Trade shall be the rates set out in Table I.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
